subject.title: Nix: speed up gateway builds and enforce cache-only CI consumers

question: Should maintainers rebase/apply the remaining source-builder `mv` optimization onto current main, or close this branch as superseded by the current gateway packaging split?
rationale: Current main already contains the safety and `dontFixup` pieces, but the remaining install-semantic change touches source-override packaging and the live branch is dirty, so automation should not choose whether to carry that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Rebase narrowly
options.body: Preserve current `dist-runtime`, plugin manifest, bundled skills/templates, cleanup, symlink validation, and wrapper-default behavior while applying only any still-wanted move optimization.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: If the source-builder move optimization is no longer worth carrying after the npm-shrinkwrap default path, close this stale branch manually.

recommendation.title: Rebase narrowly
recommendation.body: Preserve current `dist-runtime`, plugin manifest, bundled skills/templates, cleanup, symlink validation, and wrapper-default behavior while applying only any still-wanted move optimization.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the branch trim and recent overlapping gateway packaging split, making them the best available owner for the rebase-or-close choice.
